scope: One bounded DRAO code-coordinate header qualification on an independently frozen complete day. No target identity, target values, observation records, navigation product, orbit, residual or orbital score is accessed.

coordinate_policy.rinex3_scale_factor: Divide each stored code value by its declared SYS / SCALE FACTOR; missing means one.
coordinate_policy.applied_external_corrections: Any nonblank GPS SYS / DCBS APPLIED or SYS / PCVS APPLIED entry is fatal without its independently frozen product.
coordinate_policy.receiver_clock: RCV CLOCK OFFS APPL must be zero or absent.
coordinate_policy.phase_headers: SYS / PHASE SHIFT and WAVELENGTH FACT L1/2 are outside this code-only contract and cannot admit or reject it.
coordinate_policy.coverage: TIME OF FIRST OBS and TIME OF LAST OBS must declare the exact full day. This header audit does not establish body-record continuity.

terminal_policy: This artifact is closed after one outcome. Do not select another date or relax C1C/C2W if it fails. Passing qualifies header coordinate semantics only; structural continuity and the physical error envelope remain separate blockers.
